There was a good deal of talk about the weather and about the trains, and a few people asked whether the session would run as long as it had the previous year. The coordinator said that it would, more or less, and that there would be a break in the middle of the day.

The first part of the session was mostly a discussion of what the group had done the year before and what they hoped to do next.
